name: AI in Consumer, Media and Communications: The One-Hour Briefing
description: A free one-hour briefing built on twelve real jobs across retail, consumer brands, fashion, hospitality, telecom, media and gaming, not an overview of "AI in consumer business". Each lesson follows a named role through one task, such as a service lead launching a returns bot, a merchandiser whose product feed now also feeds AI shopping agents, a reviews analyst publishing an AI summary or a hotel revenue manager approving an RMS rate, and shows where AI helps, where it must not decide, and the rule that governs that task.
fieldOfStudy: AI in Consumer, Media and Communications

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 9 lessons in 3 modules; and pass the final exam: 10 questions, 15 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
